conditions.detected_removal: remove every candidate flagged by CF-CMD-U
conditions.random_matched_removal: remove the same total number of candidate samples using a fixed seed-blinded random permutation
conditions.oracle_poison_removal: remove all 60 poison samples and no clean candidates

retraining.qml: local-angle QML clean model from scratch, up to 40 epochs, followed by the frozen five-epoch backdoor adaptation when poisons remain
retraining.test_use: one-shot post-training balanced CA and ASR
